dedupe_keys.name: lannion tregor communaute coastal flood and storm surge hazard datasets

description: Lannion-Trégor Communauté: coastal flood and storm surge hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Lannion-Trégor Communauté. Coverage: Lannion-Trégor Communauté. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about coastal flood and storm surge hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Bande des 100m en recul du trait de côte histolitt (Territoire de Lann; Nature du trait de côte; Durée analysée pour l'évolution du trait de côte. Formats seen: URL, GEOJSON, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
